given.note: Lee Associates has the sensitive switch on. A client gave the name only in Chinese characters, 张伟, the security reviewer's example of a common two-character name (a placeholder, no real person). Each Chinese character is a whole syllable and here a whole name part, so initials of them would spell the name; no part has a letter that can be an initial, as D41's form gives none for a word with no Latin letter. The client's first session with Maya on Sat Nov 7 at 1:00pm still goes on Maya's Outlook calendar, as 'Visit' alone, with initials null (RULES 4.6; S13-22; arch 05 line 267; README default 18). The session's date, length and ids are an illustration.
